purpose: Prefer producing a useful Difficulty Score for as many machines as possible while separating score magnitude from exposure-model confidence.

proposedExposureQualities.meaning: Target games map directly to Feature trials.
Trials are uniquely derivable from verified parent rates/structure.
Trials are reasonably estimable but depend on explicit behavioral/model assumptions; confidence must be shown.

scorePolicy.principle: Do not suppress a machine score merely because some trials are not exact. Use ESTIMATED where a transparent model is defensible.
scorePolicy.evidenceDominant: No numeric score when there is no practically adopted numeric inference Feature; show rejected Features and required trials instead.

features.reason: Contextual predecessor sample is not generated by the user's target games; keep outside intrinsic machine Difficulty.

features.exposureModel: 1 trial per self-play normal G.
REG category rate from self-play outcome × target games.
1 trial per normal/AT G.
RB rate × expected usable portion of nominal 50G C.C.-high interval, truncated by intervening bonus.
features.uncertainty: Eligibility exclusions and resets/interruptions need exact behavior modeling.

features.exposureModel: Renewal/Markov estimate from setting-specific bonus type rates and post-bonus AT lengths (RB 50G+, BB/HBB 150G).
features.uncertainty: AT carry-over/extension and bonus-inside-AT behavior must be represented; model not yet implemented.

features.exposureModel: Use Phase 9.3 AT-nonresident trial-G definition as explicit estimated basis until official denominator is known.
Phase 9.3 AT-nonresident basis minus 8G per observed CZ; retains estimated basis confidence.
AT-end trial rate ≈ AT-initial rate / (1 - return probability), conditional on estimated AT-initial basis.
CZ-cycle starts proxied by CZ occurrence/cycle renewal rate; requires validation against actual cycle reset behavior.

machines.note: Keep rejected numeric candidates prominent; BONUS initial requires ~423,584G under the current 80% discrimination criterion.

features.exposureModel: 1 trial per bonus-eligible G.
Blue-BIG occurrence rate × ascertainment factor. Do not hard-code 0.7; model an explicit ascertainment interval or profile.
REG occurrence rate × ascertainment factor. Use interval/profile rather than an arbitrary single percentage.
Published per-G CZ rate can be used as a high-confidence estimate; exact comparison basis still needs definition.

Estimate lamp-trial rate from CZ rate divided by expected CZ-hit probability per lamp color mixture; current calculation uses published setting-1 color-specific hit expectations as a transfer assumption.
features.uncertainty: Color-specific hit expectations are published for setting 1; transfer across settings is an assumption.

features.exposureModel: BIG occurrence rate × target games.
1 trial per total G.
1 trial per normal G.
Hitogami entry rate × normal G.
Stage-change rate ≈ 1/53G × valid-transition fraction. Current valid fraction range 15/19–16/19 depending on post-AT exclusion pattern.
features.uncertainty: Average stage stay and post-AT/non-post-AT mixture create modest model uncertainty.

features.exposureModel: 1 trial per total G.
Published AT-initial rate plus a model converting total play G to AT-initial-eligible G; retain observed-ratio input for real inference.
features.uncertainty: Normal/AT time share or equivalent renewal model is needed.

features.exposureModel: Renewal estimate of 200G-zone reaches from normal-cycle survival to 200G; requires AT/CZ cycle model or empirical denominator distribution.
features.uncertainty: Zone/mode and early-hit behavior materially affect trial frequency.

auditConclusion.keyChange: Previously excluded special-trial Features should generally be reintroduced as ESTIMATED when a transparent exposure model can be defined.
implementationOrder: Add ESTIMATED exposure quality and confidence metadata
Re-score Revue Starlight and Mushoku first
Then Code Geass and Tokyo Ghoul
Bakemonogatari last because it needs the richest renewal model
